// ConnectionStrings note: Development-only LocalDB placeholder with integrated security; no secret. Override with user-secrets or the ConnectionStrings__PenguinPlankDatabase environment variable (for example SQL Express: Server=.\SQLEXPRESS;...). Production values come from the environment, never from this file.
// FileStore note: RootPath MUST be a directory OUTSIDE the web root (never under wwwroot or served content). Media binaries live outside the web root and the relational database (requirement 6.8 / A4); the API serves them only through the authorized download endpoint. ImageMaxBytes/VideoMaxBytes default to 20 MB / 200 MB (requirement 6.10) and may be overridden here.
